runtime.public_note: WiTE2 1.05.02 实机从 7 月 3 日开局推进至 7 月 10 日苏方后勤完成。B-17F 生产 40 架，B-17G、P-51B/D 均为零。三个关闭战区内驻军为零。全战役事件及换装路径另按剧本数据核对，未实跑至 1945 年。 另用独立存档清空全部 221 种候选机型库存并停止相应生产，经过一次苏方后勤，西方航空队中苏制机仍为零。 在同一诊断档提前触发包括 D-Day、上下诺曼底和巴黎解放在内的六个事件，卡昂、鲁昂、巴黎、罗马、巴勒莫仍全部为轴心控制。与同阶段对照档逐项核对的 522 个西欧和意大利地点控制方全部一致。

previous_release_verification.prior_runtime_evidence: Before this revision, the user verified six railway groups repairing track and next-week repair settlement, selected reinforcements/replacements, amphibious landings and supply. These do not certify every newly restored formation.
comprehensive_check_limits: Static and offline native checks; no full live launch/aircraft-capacity/random-scatter simulation.
Legacy native editor validation was not rerun through the UI; no assertion of zero legacy errors, balanced outcomes or complete Western AI.

Eligible Western units contribute to the denominator.
